messages:
Tara (Support): ACME reported a sudden burst of 504s hitting /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1 around 13:12 UTC. Checkout flow impacted, customer escalated. Dash: https://grafana.redwood/prod/boards/req-504s

ops-bot: ALERT: prod-us-east-1 gateway 5xx spike 13:12-13:20 (~120 errors). Incident INC-10234 opened.

Maria L.: I'm taking this. Can someone paste a sample request or req_id so I can reproduce quickly? I'll pull KEDA/HPA metrics.

Tara (Support): Customer sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-7b","input":"checkout total"}'
```
They got a 504 with no body. Spike start 13:11:50, lasted ~7 minutes.

deploy-bot: No prod deploys in last 4h in us-east-1.

Maria L.: KEDA/ScaledObject for inference-workers-prod shows: pollIntervalSeconds=30, cooldownPeriodSeconds=300, minReplicaCount=0, maxReplicaCount=50. HPA target CPU 50%. Queue backlog rose to ~6k. Scale-ups were delayed because cooldown prevented rapid subsequent scales.

Alex P.: Model cold init measured ~20-30s for the first process. Readiness becomes true after model load, but first requests still hit KV cache misses adding 5-10s. With KEDA cooldown and minReplicaCount=0, end-to-end time before capacity available exceeded 120s.

Samir K.: Sounds like misconfigured scaling for bursty traffic. Short-term mitigation: set minReplicaCount=1 for this tenant pool and reduce KEDA cooldown/polling to allow faster reaction. Proposed patch:
```
kubectl patch scaledobject inference-workers-prod -n prod-acme --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":1,"pollingIntervalSeconds":5,"cooldownPeriodSeconds":30}}'
```
This should allow rapid scale to handle short spikes.

Tara (Support): I'll coordinate applying that to the prod-acme namespace now, need infra blessing.

Samir K.: Agreed. Also recommend a short-lived routing override to send this tenant to a burst-capacity pool if we have one; fallback is the KEDA patch.

Tara (Support): Applying patch to prod-acme.

deploy-bot: kubectl patch applied to scaledobject/inference-workers-prod in namespace prod-acme.

Maria L.: Watching the autoscaler: replicas climbed 2 -> 8 within ~45s of the patch. Queue drained and 504s dropped back to baseline.

Leah (CS): Customer confirmed errors stopped and traffic is flowing. They asked for a postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

Samir K.: Action items: short-term keep minReplicaCount=1 for 24h and cooldown=30s (done). Medium-term add tenant priority routing and automated burst pool assignment. Long-term implement pre-warm hooks for model init and allow configurable pre-warm on scale-up. I'll open INFRA ticket INFRA-2145 for routing + warmup work.

Tara (Support): Updating INC-10234 with notes and will send customer a summary. Monitoring for 1h before reverting. :thumbsup:

Maria L.: I'll attach Grafana panels, KEDA/HPA snapshots, and the sample curl to the incident doc along with recommended tuned settings.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 5xx spike mitigated. Follow-ups created: INFRA-2145, INC-10234-PT
